culturalBackground: Simple mehndi is built from basic elements: dots, lines, petals, leaves and vines.
A single trail across the hand or a small motif on the palm is the most common layout.
It is the best starting point for beginners because every shape is easy to repeat.
Most simple designs can be finished in 10 to 20 minutes.
applicationTips: Practise each shape on paper before moving to skin.
Squeeze the cone with steady, light pressure and let the paste fall onto the skin instead of dragging the tip.
Fix small mistakes at once with a cotton bud before the paste stains.

faqPool.q: Which mehndi design is best for beginners?
faqPool.a: A single floral vine from the index finger towards the wrist. It uses only petals, leaves and dots.

faqPool.q: How long does a simple mehndi design take?
Can simple mehndi be worn to a wedding?
faqPool.a: Yes. A neat simple design on the back of the hand suits guests well.
